Kindle Week: Kindle Paperwhite entra em promoção e tem 34% de desconto
Kindle Paperwhite de 16 GB com tela de 7 polegadas e bateria de até 12 semanas fica mais barato que o Kindle padrão na Amazon
O Kindle Paperwhite de 12ª geração está disponível por R$ 759 em até 10x sem juros na Amazon. O leitor de e-books com tela de 7 polegadas e 17 LEDs de iluminação, cujo preço foi reajustado recentemente para R$ 1.149, recebe 34% de desconto e fica mais barato que o Kindle padrão.
Vale dizer que a Kindle Week da Amazon começou nesta segunda-feira (31) e vai até o próximo domingo (6) com vários descontos relacionados ao e-reader e e-books.
O Kindle Paperwhite adota uma tela e-ink antirreflexo de 7 polegadas com 17 LEDs de iluminação embutidos, superior em tamanho e em relação aos 4 LEDs do Kindle padrão. Assim, o modelo reproduz imagens com maior nitidez e alto contraste, além de promover uma leitura mais agradável em qualquer ambiente.
A experiência com o leitor fica ainda melhor com o recurso de brilho e temperatura de luz ajustável. Disponível a partir da versão Paperwhite, essa função possibilita deixar a tela mais favorável para leitura sob a luz mais intensa do sol ou em um quarto escuro de madrugada.
Outro atrativo do Kindle Paperwhite é a longa bateria de 12 semanas com uma única carga, o dobro do Kindle padrão. Ou seja, você pode carregar o aparelho uma vez via USB-C e usá-lo regularmente por até três meses sem preocupações.
O e-reader da Amazon tem armazenamento interno de 16 GB, garantindo espaço de sobra para livros, revistas e quadrinhos. O usuário pode utilizar a conexão Wi-Fi para acessar a loja de e-books da Amazon com mais de 3 milhões de obras ou receber arquivos em PDF, DOCX e outros formatos.
Para quem gosta de ler em qualquer lugar, o aparelho tem certificado IPX8 de resistência à água, que o permite ficar submerso por até 2 metros em água doce por 1 hora. Com isso, o usuário pode curtir seus livros perto de banheiras, piscinas ou pias sem riscos.
Fechando o pacote, o Kindle Paperwhite (R$ 759 em até 10x sem juros) possui estrutura fabricada com 29% de materiais reciclados. Mantendo o foco em sustentabilidade, a embalagem do produto é feita com 99% de material reciclável.
Aviso de ética: ao clicar em um link de afiliado, o preço não muda para você e recebemos uma comissão.

articles.title: xTool F2 Ultra UV dual laser engraver review: So cool it’s hot
articles.text:
Tom's Hardware Verdict
The xTool F2 Ultra UV is a fast UV laser that cuts and engraves wood without char, engraves plastic, and does amazing things with crystal and glass. xTool has excellent software and support for the business of selling your works of art. However, a premium piece of equipment also comes with a premium price.
Pros
- +Integrated Enclosure
- +Accurate camera preview
- +Touch screen
- +Intuitive software
Cons
- -No safety glasses provided
- -cannot cut through metal
Why you can trust Tom's Hardware
The xTool F2 Ultra UV laser is not your ordinary laser. Normally, lasers mark, engrave, and cut by burning the material. Instead, a UV laser uses a shorter wavelength of light (355 nm) that produces a photochemical reaction that breaks down the material instead of simply setting it on fire. These are called “cold” lasers, but I still wouldn’t put my hand in there.
The UV laser generates extremely clean cuts and engravings in wood and plastic that are simply not possible with other types of lasers. It's also able to etch glass and crystal, and can actually engrave the INSIDE of glass for some fantastic effects.
The F2 Ultra UV is a galvo laser. Instead of moving around on a gantry, the laser is stationary while the beam is directed by galvanometer mirrors. It’s extremely fast and capable of “moving” at 15,000 mm/s. The downfall of many galvo lasers is that they lose focus the farther away from the center point the beam travels. At the edges of the 200 x 200 mm work area, the F2 Ultra UV still does a great job.
The F2 Ultra UV is part of a family of lasers. The F2 is a portable “standard” diode laser, the F1 Ultra has both a diode and a fiber laser for etching metal, and the F2 Ultra is a 60W MOPA with a 40W diode. I wish the UV laser had been given its own class, as this is a confusing cluster of machines.
The retail price for the F2 Ultra UV starts at $4,299. It's pricey, but it can handle everything but metal and is the only laser that can handle crystal. This makes it a good all-around machine for many home and business uses. For that, it’s going on the best laser cutter list for a small business.
Specifications: xTool F2 Ultra UV
| Machine Footprint | 294 mm x 429 mm x 520 mm (11.57'' × 16.88'' × 20.5'') | 
| Machine Weight | 22.5 kg (49.6 lbs) | 
| Engraving Size | 200 mm × 200 mm (7.9" × 7.9") | 
| Inner Engraving Size | 70 mm x 70 mm (2.8” x 2.8”) | 
| Engravable Material | Glass, Crystal, Acrylic, Wood, Metal, Leather, Plastic, Rubber, Silicone, Ceramic | 
| Cuttable Material | Glass, Plastics, Fabric, Leather, Acrylic (Not Fully Transparent), Paper, Wood | 
| Laser Type | 355 nm UV | 
| Laser Power | 5w | 
| Cutting Platform | Included (flat, slatted panel, and riser) | 
| Connectivity | USB, WI-FI/IP | 
| Interface | Corded Touch Screen with Start Button | 
| MSRP | $4,299.00 | 
| Pre-order Launch | November 14, 2025 | 
xTool F2 Ultra UV: Included in the Box
The xTool F2 Ultra comes fully assembled, with the surface engraving lens in place. The inner engraving lens and riser are packed in a reusable foam box. Also included is a slatted cutting plate, corded touch screen, equipment safety key, surface engraving material pack, tool kit, cables, and paper copies of the quick start guide and safety instructions, For the review, we also received the optional button and pedal switches, rotary attachment, the xTool SafetyPro AP2 fume extractor, and a bunch of glass and crystal materials for testing.
Design of the xTool F2 Ultra
The xTool F2 Ultra UV is a galvo laser with a 355-nanometer wavelength. At this wavelength, the laser marks by way of a cold photochemical process rather than just burning. Unlike a flat bed laser, which has the laser on an XY carriage and moves across the work area, a galvo laser is fixed in place and moved with two galvanometer mirrors. Since these mirrors are small and light, they can be used to move the laser beam extremely fast, up to 15,000 mm/s.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
The only downside is that the laser’s work area is roughly cone-shaped, and the beam tends to lose focus the farther it moves from the center. The xTool F2 Ultra UV does an excellent job cutting and engraving throughout the entire 200 x 200 mm work area.
The xTool F2 Ultra UV comes with a lens for surface engraving and cutting and a lens for inner engraving. These attach to the laser with a quarter turn.
The inner engraving lens requires the installation of the included riser, which is attached to the baseplate of the laser with two thumb screws.
The xTool F2 Ultra UV has a nicely counterbalanced cover which slides down for protection against direct or scattered laser radiation. The laser will not operate without the cover in place, unless this safety feature is disabled in the printer’s software. We only needed to do this while using the optional rotary attachment.
On the right side of the machine, there is a large red emergency stop button, the regular power button, A USB-C port for attaching a PC to the laser, and a USB-A port for moving files to the laser from a USB drive.
The machine has an excellent corded touch screen which is used to start each print and resume after an alarm or other pause in printing. It shows files available to print from a USB drive and can reprint the last file without the need to resend it. While printing, the screen shows elapsed time and time remaining on the current job.
The xTool F2 Ultra UV has dual 48 MP cameras for positioning, with an accuracy of .2 mm. For surface engraving, the camera did not require calibration, as the positioning was perfect. After attaching the Inner engraving lens, it’s a good idea to calibrate the Z-Axis, which will also require calibrating the inner engraving work area. Our Z-Axis starting point was pretty far off the mark.
The auto focus function works perfectly on everything except glass. Since the beam goes through the glass, a piece of tape or scrap paper needs to be held to the surface to be lasered, and the focus can be set manually from the touch screen. Once the focus is correct, you can subtract out the thickness of the paper, but that level of precision is not really necessary.
The bottom plate of the laser is anodized aluminum, with threaded holes for positioning jigs and the inner engraving riser. Also included is the black plate for cutting material.
For fume extraction, we received the Safety Pro AP2 air purifier. While the xTool F2 Ultra UV does engrave cooler, it still produces a good deal of smoke when cutting and engraving wood and plastics. Engraving glass doesn’t produce smoke, but it does produce a fine powder of glass, which is mostly sucked into the purifier. The laser has a fan to extract fumes from the chamber, but it must be vented to the outside.
If you aren’t up for installing an exterior vent, the Safety Pro AP2 is a great, though somewhat pricey, choice. It has a six-stage filter that removes every trace of smoke from the air. With the F2 Ultra UV, the Safety Pro AP2 can be set to run automatically when needed, and the filter life cycle is monitored in the xTool App. The filters last between 100 and 600 hours and cost between $20 and $60 presently. The top SuperCyclone filter is cleanable and reusable.
Assembling the xTool F2 Ultra UV
The xTool F2 Ultra UV is fully assembled from the factory with the surface engraving lens installed. Setup requires removing the metal bracket which secures the laser head for shipping.
The power cord, touch screen, and exhaust hose attach to the rear of the laser, as does the equipment key. With those in place you are ready to go.
Safety Precautions for the xTool F2 Ultra UV
The xTool F2 Ultra UV is a Class 4 laser, which is the highest and most hazardous class of laser. Direct and reflected laser light can cause damage to eyes and burns on skin. The processing of certain materials can produce toxic fumes. Care should be taken when operating this and any laser.
The F2 Ultra UV has an impressive list of safety features to make your experience less hazardous. The enclosure traps both dangerous light and fumes inside it and is set to stop the current process if opened. This safety stop can be overridden in the software, and needs to be for larger jobs and jobs requiring the rotary attachment. The safety will need to be turned back on manually. The machine has a flame sensor which is needed for cutting and engraving wood and plastic. Though the UV laser cuts and engraves cooler than the usual diode and CO2 lasers, it is still possible to cause a fire at higher power levels. If the laser is moved or tilted while in use, it will shut off automatically. As is usual with larger power tools, the xTool F2 Ultra UV has a USB equipment key plugged in the rear of the unit. If little hands are about or if the machine will be idle for a while, this key can be pulled, rendering the laser unable to function. There is also a large red emergency stop button on the side of the machine that can be used to quickly turn the machine off in the event of fire or other immediate issue.
For smoke and other potentially toxic fumes, the xTool F2 Ultra UV has an exhaust fan on the rear of the unit, which needs to be vented to the outside or to a purifier like the Safety Pro AP2. Some materials like PVC and fiberglass should not be burned with a laser due to their chemical makeup. Dallas Maker Space has published a list of safe and hazardous materials to use with their laser.
One necessary safety precaution xTool has stopped providing is safety glasses. They are a good idea if you are operating the laser without the cover in place and are available from xTool on their website.
Software for xTool F2 Ultra UV
xTool Studio was frustrating when it was first launched and replaced xTool Creative Space. It took some time for all of xTool’s tutorials, material settings, and the maker community as a whole to catch up with the new program. Studio is now what I’ve come to expect and love about xTool. It is the most intuitive and powerful design software I’ve used from any of the major manufactures. It is also simple enough to get good results without being an expert.
While xTool offers a bunch of free tools to make your projects easier, they also have some excellent tools that cost credits to use. I despise microtransactions in all software. In this case, the credits are not super expensive and can be earned for posting your projects to Atomm, xTool’s file-sharing platform, and for other tasks. There are also currently 3 free uses a month. At best, I can say that there isn’t an annual subscription required to access these tools. They are optional and work well if you don’t have other options for things like removing the background from an image or converting it to a vector.
Atomm is available from the home page and offers a ton of projects, mostly free, to give you ideas or just something to create outright. It also has a bunch of tools to create everything from custom key chains to puzzles to boxes.
Engraving / Cutting with the xTool F2 Ultra UV
The xTool F2 Ultra UV is a powerful laser. Five watts doesn't sound like a lot, but it can cut through 15 mm of basswood and 12 mm of acrylic using multiple passes, which is respectable, and it can cut without the usual charring you expect with a diode or CO2 laser.
The UV laser can engrave metal but is really not up to cutting it. For metal cutting, you may want to check out the MOPA-powered F2 Ultra.
xTool has excellent material profiles that cover nearly everything you might want to cut or engrave. They also sell almost everything you might want to engrave, with an eye toward using your F2 Ultra UV as a business.
The first test I ran was engraving and cutting out a picture of my dog Ripley. The material is 3mm bass plywood, and I used the default settings. For the engraving, I used 90% power with a dot duration of 800 and using Jarvis mode. For the cut, it was 100% power at 146 mm/s for 44 passes.
To prep the photo I used the AI background remover in xTool Studio which cost 6 credits and sharpened the photo using the free tools. The resulting image is really nice. Using the offset function, I put a cutline around the image and the laser cut it with no charring at all. It might be the cleanest laser cut I’ve ever seen. 44 passes sounds like a lot to cut 3mm plywood but, with the speed of this laser the entire process took only 4 minutes and 28 sec.
I was intrigued by the F2 Ultra UV’s marking ability on plastic, since it’s much cooler than other lasers. I printed some generic squares to test this out of Bambu Lab silver ABS and Inland white high speed ABS+. Since there is such a wide variety of plastic out there I ran some test arrays using xTool’s black 3D printing ABS material preset as a starting place. The grids were generated by xTool Studio and took only 2 minutes each to print. I learned three things from these tests: It is possible to finely engrave/mark plastic with the F2 Ultra UV. It is also possible to set it on fire. Lastly the Safety Pro AP2 is fantastic at keeping the smell of burning ABS from overwhelming my workshop.
The xTool RA3 rotary attachment can be set to use rollers for cylindrical objects or a chuck to grab onto the inside or outside of items, from rings to tumblers. It works perfectly well; just make sure you choose the correct node since the calculations needed are wildly different.
Using the text editor in xTool Studio, I engraved an old coffee mug. Using the white glazed ceramic board material preset, the laser was able to break through the glazing and fairly deep into the ceramic at 100% power at 88 MM/s in 2 passes. It took a while: 40 minutes total. The resulting cut had a nice light blue left over from the glaze. I ran a silver Sharpie permanent marker over the letters to make them pop.
The xTool F2 Ultra UV does an excellent job engraving directly on glass. I used clip art and text from Canva and inverted the image using the free tool in xTool Studio. The image must be inverted to etch correctly on glass. Using 80% with a dot duration of 400 and 1 pass, this took 4 minutes and 15 seconds and looks fantastic. Sadly we were out of bourbon to show it off.
The switch to the inner engraving lens is mostly painless. Mostly. It’s a little unsettling since the lens is far inside the body of the laser housing, so I was working by feel to make the swap. The riser bolts easily onto the middle of the base with two thumb screws.
Because inner engraving is three-dimensional, you can use “normal” 3D printing STL files. For the first inner engraving, I chose a classic: Aria the Dragon by Loubie3D.
I also added text to the bottom of the engraving. This was when I realized that the Z-axis needed to be calibrated for inner engraving, so now I have Loubie3D etched on the surface of the riser permanently. After calibrating the Z-axis, the inner engraving work area must be calibrated too.
The inner engraving looks like magic and takes quite a bit of time to process. Using the dotting engraving method at 70% power and 200 dot duration, with a .01 layer height and a .02 point spacing, the engraving took 5 hours and 7 minutes. The result, other than the riser being engraved too, was amazing.
Probably the most impressive thing I’ve ever engraved is this crystal ball. Engraving a crystal ball is more of a production than the other inner engraving, since it requires the ball to be immersed in liquid that is approximately the same refractive index as the crystal. We used mineral oil and initially attempted to use a Pyrex measuring cup to hold everything in place.
Based on that experience, I highly recommend the xTool kit, which includes the silicone pad to keep things centered and a beaker with easily read measuring lines. It was nearly impossible to center the engraving without this. Even with the xTool kit, it requires a steady hand to avoid slopping oil around.
The engraving took 5 hours and 7 minutes at 40% power and a dot duration of 180 with a .04 layer height and a .02 point spacing. The resulting detail is just phenomenal.
Bottom Line
I feel like I’ve just scratched the surface of what the xTool F2 Ultra UV can do. While it cuts and engraves wood as well as most of the lasers I’ve tested, its ability to engrave glass and plastic is unusual. The inner engraving is just magic, bordering on witchcraft. It does not take a rocket scientist to see the sales potential of items easily crafted with this machine.
Starting at $4,299, the F2 Ultra is a bit of an investment. But it earns its keep by delivering outstanding crystal engravings that no other laser can deliver.
If you’re not ready to make such a sizable investment, the portable xTool F1 laser is still available for $819 and is great for taking to festivals for personalizing merch on the go. If you want to laser large things safely tucked inside an enclosure – including clear acrylic – check out the xTool P2 CO2 laser, which is on sale for $3,399.
Denise Bertacchi is a Contributing Writer for Tom’s Hardware US, covering 3D printing. Denise has been crafting with PCs since she discovered Print Shop had clip art on her Apple IIe. She loves reviewing 3D printers because she can mix all her passions: printing, photography, and writing.

articles.title: JBL Cove : un ensemble d'enceintes multiroom qui va faire trembler Sonos — Frandroid
articles.text:
Pour sonoriser plusieurs pièces de la maison, l’une des références, c’est Sonos et ses enceintes plus ou moins compactes qui s’installent facilement et permettent de diffuser des musiques différentes ou le même titre partout. Pour concurrencer cela, JBL lance la série Cove.
    Pour aller plus loin
            Amazon Echo, Google Nest, HomePod… quelles sont les meilleures enceintes connectées en 2026 ?
            
Selon la marque, cet ensemble de trois enceintes doit permettre de profiter d’un son de qualité dans chaque pièce de la maison, sans complexité d’installation. La gamme s’articule autour de trois références aux positionnements distincts.
La JBL Cove M1 se présente comme le modèle d’entrée de gamme, au format compact, pensé pour une écoute quotidienne simple.
La JBL Cove P1 est la version portable de la gamme : elle embarque une batterie annoncée pour une autonomie allant jusqu’à 14 heures, rechargeable sur une station dédiée, et profite d’une certification IP56 la rendant résistante à la poussière et aux projections d’eau.
Votre production solaire dépasse votre consommation ? Le SolarFlow 2400 AC+ stocke automatiquement votre surplus dans vos batteries. 100 % compatible avec la grande majorité des installations solaires en toiture, il permet de faire évoluer votre système simplement et à moindre coût.
Enfin, la JBL Cove X1 est le modèle phare de la série, doté de quatre tweeters et de deux woofers pour un rendu sonore plus ample.
Dolby Atmos et autocalibration au programme
D’après le fabricant, seules les JBL Cove P1 et X1 intègrent la technologie Dolby Atmos, leur conception à deux voies devant permettre une meilleure restitution spatiale. Chaque enceinte peut fonctionner seule, être associée en paire stéréo, ou intégrée à un système multiroom plus large regroupant plusieurs appareils dans différentes pièces.
JBL met également en avant trois technologies communes à l’ensemble de la gamme : le Constant Sound Field, censé garantir un son homogène dans toute la pièce quel que soit l’emplacement de l’auditeur, un calibrage automatique qui ajuste le rendu selon l’acoustique de la pièce et la position de l’enceinte, ainsi que l’AI Sound Boost, destinée à limiter la distorsion sonore lorsque le volume est poussé, déjà utilisée sur d’autres enceintes de la marque dont les JBL Flip 7, Xtreme 5 et Go 5 mais aussi les enceintes de soirée.
Une intégration poussée à l’écosystème home cinéma de la marque
Au-delà de l’écoute musicale, JBL Cove a été conçue pour s’intégrer à l’univers home cinéma du fabricant. Ainsi, les enceintes se connectent aux barres de son de la série JBL Bar MK2, qui s’articule autour des modèles 300, 500, 800, 1000 et 1300. Depuis l’application JBL One, il est possible d’associer les enceintes Cove à une barre de son en tant que canaux arrière, afin de constituer une installation Dolby Atmos plus immersive.
Au lancement, cette compatibilité concerne les modèles Cove P1 et M1, la Cove X1 rejoignant cette fonction pour la seule diffusion de musique en multiroom, d’après la marque.
Côté fonctionnalités pratiques, JBL met en avant la fonction Music Follows Me, qui permet de faire suivre la musique ou le son du téléviseur d’une pièce à l’autre grâce à une simple pression sur un bouton dédié, sans recourir à un smartphone ou à l’application. La marque promet également une installation en trois étapes, utilisable même sans application mobile, ainsi qu’un système de regroupement flexible pour diffuser du son dans une seule pièce ou dans l’ensemble du logement sans avoir à dissocier ni réinitialiser les enceintes.
Une large connectivité pour s’adapter à tous
En matière de connectivité, les JBL Cove se veulent très polyvalentes. Elles prennent en charge le Wi-Fi, le Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Roon Ready, ainsi que les services Spotify Connect, Tidal Connect et Qobuz Connect, avec une compatibilité audio haute résolution. La fonction Spotify Tap permet de lancer la lecture d’une simple pression sur un bouton dédié.
JBL annonce par ailleurs une compatibilité future avec l’assistant Alexa+, qui sera activée via une mise à jour à distance plus tard dans l’année, mais uniquement aux États-Unis dans un premier temps, ce qui exclut de fait le marché français pour cette fonctionnalité vocale à ce stade.
Disponibilité et prix des enceintes JBL Cove
Les enceintes JBL Cove seront proposées en deux coloris : noir ou blanc. Selon les informations communiquées par la marque, la JBL Cove M1 sera commercialisée au prix de 229,99 euros, la JBL Cove P1 à 449,99 euros et la JBL Cove X1 à 499,99 euros.
Ces tarifs placent JBL au contact direct de Sonos, sa cible affichée. À titre de comparaison, la Sonos Era 100, la compacte de la gamme, s’affiche autour de 230 euros, tandis que la Sonos Era 300, plus imposante et compatible Dolby Atmos, est vendue neuve aux alentours de 400 euros actuellement. La JBL Cove M1 et la Cove X1 viennent donc se caler très précisément sur ces deux repères.

articles.title: Quando vamos ver imagens do Universo feitas pelo Telescópio Roman?
articles.text:
Após ser lançado neste domingo (30), o Telescópio Espacial Nancy Grace Roman segue para sua órbita ao redor do segundo ponto de Lagrange Sol-Terra, conhecido como L2, a cerca de 1,6 milhão de quilômetros da Terra. É de lá que ele vai trabalhar para construir um verdadeiro atlas panorâmico do cosmos.
De acordo com a NASA, o equipamento será capaz de realizar um mapeamento inédito e em larga escala que promete transformar nossa visão sobre a estrutura do espaço. Mas quando vamos ver as primeiras imagens do Universo feitas pelo Telescópio Roman? Marcelo Zurita, astrônomo e colunista do Olhar Digital, responde.
Pres. Associação Paraibana de Astronomia; membro da Sociedade Astronômica Brasileira; diretor técnico da Rede Brasileira de Observação de Meteoros – e coordenador regional do Asteroid Day Brasil

articles.title: Adiós a las estafas: One UI 9 llevará una de las mejores funciones de los Pixel a más Samsung Galaxy
articles.text:
Una de las mejores funciones de los Google Pixel para acabar con los llamados fraudulentos está cerca de llegar a más Samsung Galaxy. Nos referimos a la detección de estafas, que podría expandirse a un número mayor de modelos de la marca coreana de la mano de One UI 9.
Según reporta Android Authority, la beta de One UI 9 incluye referencias a la expansión de la detección de estafas que Google originalmente lanzó como una característica exclusiva de los Pixel. Dicha herramienta ya se encuentra disponible en los Samsung Galaxy S26 y en los plegables Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra y Flip 8, pero en cuestión de meses estaría dando el salto a modelos previos.
Puntualmente, la versión en desarrollo de One UI 9 revela que la detección de estafas se incorporaría a todos los teléfonos que conforman la línea Galaxy S25. De modo que la próxima gran actualización de software de Samsung introduciría esta herramienta tanto en en el modelo estándar como en las variantes Plus, Ultra y Edge.
Asimismo, la característica haría su estreno en los Galaxy Z Fold 7 y Flip 7, además del Galaxy Z Trifold, el plegable triple de la marca coreana. Por ahora no se ha mencionado si la detección de estafas llegará también al Galaxy Z Flip 7 FE, la versión más económica del plegable tipo concha.
La detección de estafas llegará a más Samsung Galaxy con One UI 9
El citado reporte indica que la detección de estafas también estaría disponible en los Galaxy S27 que se lanzarán a principios de próximo año. Esto no sorprendería, considerando que la característica ya forma parte de los S26 y que los próximos buques insignia de Samsung tendrán One UI 9 preinstalado.
La detección de estafas es una de las mejores funciones que Google introdujo en Android en los últimos años. La característica se encarga de monitorear las llamadas entrantes usando un modelo de inteligencia artificial que se ejecuta directamente en el smartphone. Si el contenido de la conversación comienza a tornarse sospechoso, la función envía alertas visuales y auditivas. Además, el móvil comienza a vibrar para que el usuario preste atención y finalice la llamada antes de que el engaño se concrete.
Vale mencionar que la detección de estafas se encuentra integrada en la aplicación Teléfono, pero también funciona con SMS a través de la app Mensajes. En el caso de One UI 9, si la expansión a más modelos realmente se concreta, se trata de una adición muy interesante. Lo que todavía no está claro es si Samsung planea llevar esta herramienta a todos los móviles compatibles con dicho software, o si lo mantendrá limitada a sus buques insignia.

articles.title: Microsoft tests fix for latest hours-long Outlook outage | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Snow day? Microsoft on Monday confirmed a widespread, multi-hour outage affecting Outlook users, leading to email delays and failures, authentication issues, and other problems.
In a post on X, Microsoft reported the issue was impacting its Exchange Online service, its cloud-hosted platform for business email, calendar, contacts, and tasks, and then said it had identified the problem.
“We’ve confirmed that users may experience degraded functionality with various Exchange Online functionalities. We’re reviewing service telemetry and diagnostic data to isolate the source of the issue,” Microsoft wrote at 12:43 p.m. ET on Monday, after an earlier message saying it was investigating user reports of Exchange Online problems.
The company said that it identified an issue with an “authentication component” and is testing what it believes will be a remediation strategy with a portion of the infrastructure to determine if it resolves the problem. If so, it will roll out the solution more broadly. Later, it noted that the authentication component was impacting other services beyond Exchange.
The outage is another reminder of how much of the business world today still runs on email, and particularly Outlook and Exchange.
This has been a fairly lengthy outage, as user reports started streaming in around 11:30 a.m. ET on Monday, according to the crowdsourced outage detection website Downdetector. By 2 p.m. ET, the site was seeing north of 5,000 user reports. Meanwhile, many others were complaining directly on social media platforms, like X.
Those impacted by the outage may see delays and failures in sending or receiving messages, failures when trying to search for content in their mailbox, authentication errors, failures with mailbox operations, and other workflows related to message delivery.
As of 5 PM ET on Monday, Microsoft was still trying to resolve the problem.
This article was updated after publication as Microsoft posted more information about the status of the outage.

articles.title: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
articles.text:
JMGO’s 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO. It boosts the contrast — always an issue with projectors — by placing two separate physical apertures (irises) along different points of the internal optical path to control light scatter and brightness far more aggressively than a single iris can. It also promises to produce a very bright 6,500 ISO lumen image from its triple-laser light engine.
JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
The Iris Ultra Max brings 4K, 120Hz, VRR, ALLM, 6500 ISO lumens, and dual-iris contrast control.
Last year at IFA, 6,000 lumens from an all-in-one projector was breaking new ground. At IFA 2026, it’s shaping up to be table stakes, alongside 4k imagery purring along at a smooth 120Hz for fast-moving sports and gaming. Just note that I found JMGO’s N3 Ultimate to be unwatchable at peak brightness due to color distortion — so best wait for the reviews on this one.
Like that previous flagship, the new Iris Ultra Max is mounted on a motorized pan-and-tilt gimbal for useful Wiimote-like control. That, combined with an 0.88–1.7:1 optical zoom and V±130% / H±53% lens shift, gives you unparalleled image placement options that also preserve optical image quality.
JGMO’s also tossing in VRR and ALLM to keep latency low and reduce tearing when gaming on the IRIS Ultra Max, with support for Dolby Vision HDR at 4K 120Hz. It will eventually list for $3,499, but that drops to $2,999 for preorders that begin today, ahead of an October 19th ship date.

articles.title: KI-Anproben statt 3D-Modelle: Was moderne Virtual-Try-On-Systeme heute können
articles.text:
KI-Anproben statt 3D-Modelle: Was moderne Virtual-Try-On-Systeme heute können
Herausforderungen erkennen und lösen
Der Online-Modehandel kämpft seit Jahren mit denselben Herausforderungen: Kund:innen kaufen nicht, weil sie sich die Passform nicht vorstellen können. Gleichzeitig bestellen viele Kund:innen Kleidungsstücke in mehreren Größen und schicken einen Großteil davon wieder zurück.
Die Folgen sind enorm. Retouren zählen zu den größten Kostenfaktoren im Fashion E-Commerce. Laut National Retail Federation wurden 2025 rund 19 Prozent aller online gekauften Modeartikel in den USA retourniert. An dieser Herausforderung setzt Virtual Try-On an.
Generative KI macht Virtual Try-On massentauglich
Die Idee virtueller Anproben ist nicht neu. Neu ist die Qualität. Während frühere Lösungen aufwendig gepflegte 3D-Modelle benötigten und nur mäßige Ergebnisse lieferten, erzeugen moderne KI-Systeme heute aus üblichen Produktbildern realistische digitale Zwillinge. Computer Vision, Echtzeit-Rendering und präzises Body-Tracking lassen Kleidung und Make-up deutlich echter wirken.
Das verändert den wirtschaftlichen Nutzen der Technologie grundlegend.
Warum sich die Investition lohnt
Virtual Try-On zahlt auf drei zentrale Geschäftsziele ein:
- mehr Conversions, weil die Kaufunsicherheit sinkt
- weniger Retouren, weil Kund:innen fundiertere Entscheidungen treffen
- mehr Daten, die Personalisierung, Produktempfehlungen und Sortimentsplanung verbessern
Damit entwickelt sich VTO von einer Experience-Funktion zum Instrument für profitables Wachstum.
Dass der Wandel bereits begonnen hat, führen Unternehmen wie ASOS, Breuninger oder Maybelline vor. Sie integrieren Virtual Try-On inzwischen bewusst in ihre Customer Journey und machen KI damit zum festen Bestandteil ihres Geschäftsmodells.
Was andere Branchen daraus lernen können
Die eigentliche Innovation ist nicht Virtual Try-On allein. Die Technologie zeigt, wie Unternehmen Künstliche Intelligenz erfolgreich skalieren: Die KI löst ein konkretes Kund:innenproblem, schafft messbaren Business Value und verbessert gleichzeitig die Customer Experience.
Der bestmögliche Einsatz von KI beschäftigt heute Unternehmen weit über den Handel hinaus. Ob Finance, Energie, Robotik oder das Agentic Web: Überall geht es darum, aus einzelnen KI-Anwendungen skalierbare Geschäftsmodelle zu entwickeln.
Wer verstehen möchte, wie das gelingt, findet auf der DMEXCO 2026 inspirierende Antworten. Unter dem Motto „Scaling Intelligence“ diskutieren führende Köpfe der internationalen Digitalwirtschaft, des Marketings und des Commerce, wie Unternehmen KI erfolgreich in Wachstum übersetzen.
Dieser Frage gehen jeweils mit eigenem Fokus unter anderem der DMEXCO Thought Leaders‘ Summit, der Commerce Summit powered by BVDW und der Retail & Commerce Media Summit powered by BVDW nach.
Daneben liefern zahlreiche Masterclasses konkrete Praxiseinblicke: Statt nur über Potenziale zu sprechen, erklären Verantwortliche aus Unternehmen und Branchenexpert:innen, welche organisatorischen, technologischen und strategischen Voraussetzungen KI skalierbar machen – von Datenqualität über Agentensysteme bis hin zu neuen Customer Experiences.

articles.title: Rafa Nadal, 40 años: "Mi padre empezó desde cero y construyó la mayor empresa de cristales de Baleares"
articles.text:
Dentro de poco hará dos años que Rafael Nadal Parera puso fin a su carrera profesional. Fue en noviembre de 2024, tras una Copa Davis que acabó truncando un colofón mejor. Cerraba un carrerón de varios récords, 22 títulos de Grand Slam y dos oros olímpicos. ¿Y qué hace ahora? En su familia hay para no aburrirse: academias deportivas, centros de salud, inversiones, hoteles, renovables, inmobiliario e incluso negocios relacionados con puertos para megayates. Y todo partiendo de un negocio pequeñito y sin apenas inversión.
A sus 40 años, Rafa Nadal concedió una entrevista a CNBC desde Fuerteventura y lo recordaba así: "Mi padre fue un ejemplo muy positivo para mí en términos de dedicación y trabajo duro... fue capaz de construir la mayor empresa de cristales de Baleares empezando desde cero". Bonita historia que ahora, en una notaría de Manacor, se reconstruye. Y es mucho más interesante que el aburridísimo clásico “empezaron en un garaje”.
La empresa. Vidres Mallorca nació alrededor de esa historia familiar. Se dedica al cristal plano y de todo tipo, además de persianas. Durante décadas estuvo controlada al 50% por Sebastián Nadal, padre de Rafa, y Toni Nadal, su hermano y antiguo entrenador del tenista durante 27 años. La propia empresa sitúa sus orígenes en 1982, aunque el Registro Mercantil fija la constitución de la sociedad en 1989. Cuenta con tres plantas en Mallorca y sus instalaciones suman casi 5.000 metros cuadrados.
Durante años fue el negocio familiar que permitió construir una buena parte de la base patrimonial de los Nadal. Fabrican para empresas como Climalit y concentran su actividad en Mallorca. Pero en 2026 ocurrió algo importante: después de 37 años de sociedad conjunta, Vidres Mallorca dejó de existir como estructura única.
Los números. En su último ejercicio disponible antes de la escisión, Vidres Mallorca facturó 13,55 millones de euros y ganó 2,17 millones. Sus activos ascendían a 35,1 millones, frente a los 26,91 millones que declaraba en 2021. Entre sus propiedades había locales y viviendas repartidas por Son Servera, Manacor, Palma, Calvià y Sant Llorenç des Cardassar.
Pero el negocio no se limita a sobrevivir. En 2025, el Govern balear declaró el proyecto de Vidres Mallorca como proyecto industrial estratégico: la compañía va a por una nueva planta con la que sustituir sus instalaciones actuales, modernizar maquinaria y aumentar su capacidad productiva.
La escisión. El 18 de marzo de 2026, la junta general aprobó partir Vidres Mallorca en dos sociedades: Vidres Mallorca SXXI, que se queda con el negocio del cristal, y Rector Rubi Invest, que concentra el patrimonio inmobiliario. El reparto tampoco fue proporcional al antiguo 50/50: Sebastián Nadal se quedó con el 100% de una sociedad y Toni Nadal con el 100% de la otra.
Ni la familia ni el Registro Mercantil explican públicamente el motivo de la operación. Solo consta que fue "debidamente consentido por los socios". El resultado, sin embargo, es cristalino: el negocio industrial y el ladrillo toman caminos separados después de casi cuatro décadas.
“Vete con tu Kia”. Rafa paseando ante un concesionario, enamorándose de un Aston Martin y su padre cortando la fantasía de raíz: “¿Qué vas a hacer con un Aston Martin en Manacor? Venga, vete con el Kia”. Nada de delirios de grandeza: mientras Rafa acumulaba trofeos, Sebastián se encargaba de que los millones no se evaporaran.
Sebastián Nadal ha sido la figura clave en la gestión financiera de su hijo. Administra, entre otras estructuras, la SICAV Growth Inversiones, y ha participado durante años en la organización patrimonial que rodea al tenista. La familia ha ido construyendo así un entramado empresarial que hoy tiene poco que ver con aquella fábrica de vidrio de Manacor.
Más allá de las ventanas del padre. Rafa gestiona buena parte de sus negocios a través de Aspemir, el holding familiar administrado por su madre, Ana María Parera. La sociedad cerró 2024 con 375,4 millones de euros de patrimonio neto, además de 41,9 millones de ingresos y 14,5 millones de beneficio. Aspemir controla más de una veintena de sociedades y participaciones.
Ahí están la Rafa Nadal Academy de Manacor, la cadena hotelera ZEL, desarrollada junto a Meliá (Mallorca, Costa Brava, Punta Cana y ahora Argentina), y proyectos de nutrición y bienestar como NDL Pro-Health, creado junto a Cantabria Labs. También hay inversiones inmobiliarias, energías renovables, participaciones financieras y la productora Komodo, vinculada a proyectos como Mad Cool y producciones audiovisuales para Netflix.
El grupo sigue creciendo. En 2026, Nadal ha reforzado la expansión internacional de su academia mediante International Tennis Academies, una estructura concebida para llevar el modelo de la Rafa Nadal Academy a otros mercados. Además, ha entrado en un negocio bastante menos obvio para un tenista: las marinas para grandes embarcaciones. Aspemir tomó una participación minoritaria en Ocean Platform Marinas, compañía dedicada al desarrollo y gestión de puertos deportivos para megayates.
Otra ruptura. Con los restaurantes Tatel y Totó pasó algo parecido a lo de Vidres Mallorca, aunque por motivos y protagonistas diferentes. En 2024, Nadal y Abel Matutes rompieron su alianza con Manuel Campos dentro de Mabel Hospitaliy. Nadal y Matutes conservaron la parte inmobiliaria y otras inversiones, mientras Campos pasó a controlar la rama de restauración.
Del tenis al ladrillo de lujo. La otra gran pieza inmobiliaria está en Palya Invest, la sociedad que nació tras la ruptura de Mabel Capital. Rafa Nadal y Abel Matutes se quedaron con la parte inmobiliaria y otras inversiones, mientras que su antiguo socio Manuel Campos conservó el negocio de restauración de Tatel y Totó, el cual también tiene socios de la talla de Cristiano Ronaldo, Pau Gasol o Rudy Fernández.
Palya tiene ahora entre manos un proyecto de más de 200 millones de euros en la Costa del Sol, junto a Sierra Blanca, para desarrollar cerca de un centenar de viviendas de lujo entre Estepona y Marbella. El proyecto incluye, además del turismo náutico, residencias en primera línea de playa y otra promoción en Nagüeles.
El título. Desde junio de 2025, Rafael Nadal es formalmente marqués de Llevant de Mallorca, un título nobiliario hereditario concedido por Felipe VI. No hay plazas ni placas con su nombre en Manacor y la estatua que se propuso sigue sin erigirse. Sí hay una en la entrada de Roland Garros.
Y lo demás se circunscribe a la familia. Junto a Xisca Perelló y sus dos hijos, Rafa cuida de los suyos bajo la misma filosofía: el Aston Martin puede esperar; el verdadero patrimonio de los Nadal no se aparca en el garaje.

articles.title: Microsoft Exchange Online outage causes email failures, auth issues
articles.text:
Microsoft is investigating a widespread service issue causing authentication issues, connection problems, email delays and failures, and various other issues for Microsoft 365 customers.
It first acknowledged this incident (tracked under EX1464935 in the admin center) at 5:30 PM UTC, when it began investigating a stream of reports from users on social media regarding multiple issues affecting Exchange Online.
However, while Exchange Online is the most impacted service, Microsoft revealed in a new incident report (MO1465074) that this outage also impacts multiple other Microsoft 365 services, including OneDrive for Business and SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Defender XDR.
According to outage tracking service Downdetector, tens of thousands of Outlook and Microsoft 365 users are affected and experiencing issues receiving emails via Outlook and accessing Microsoft cloud services.
Microsoft says the list of Exchange Online symptoms includes:
- Delays or failures when sending or receiving email messages.
- Delays, failures, or incomplete results when searching for content within Exchange Online mailboxes.
- Authentication-related errors when accessing Exchange Online services.
- Difficulties accessing or performing actions within Exchange administration experiences.
- Intermittent failures affecting mailbox operations and message delivery workflows.
Although the company has yet to reveal which regions are impacted, it has classified this outage as an incident, which is typically used to describe critical service issues with noticeable user impact.
"We've isolated a common failure pattern across affected Exchange Online requests that is associated with authentication and protocol connectivity," Microsoft added in the latest admin center update.
"We're analyzing service telemetry to identify the underlying source of impact and validate potential remediation options. Additionally, we're continuing to assess the scope of impact and monitor for additional affected scenarios."
Microsoft has addressed multiple Exchange Online outages in recent months, most recently in June, when it mitigated a widespread service issue affecting the mail flow pipeline for customers across North America, Asia-Pacific (APAC), and Europe.
In April, it also resolved Exchange Online mailbox access issues that had intermittently impacted Outlook mobile and macOS users for weeks, and an Exchange Online outage that prevented users from accessing their mailboxes via Outlook on the web, Outlook desktop, Exchange ActiveSync, and other Exchange Online connection protocols.
Update August 31, 14:29 EDT: Microsoft blames the outage on core authentication configuration issues.
"We've identified issues related to a core authentication configuration used by multiple internal services within the Exchange Online infrastructure," Microsoft said. "We're performing a manual test on the individual server level to reset to configurations to validate if this resolves the issue."
Update August 31, 15:09 EDT: Microsoft now tracks this outage under MO1465074 and says the incident also affects OneDrive for Business and SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Defender XDR.

articles.title: Creating Short Fiction Scenes from Simple Prompts - Tech Guide
articles.text:
A writer thinks they have a simple idea: “A person realizes they’ve made a terrible mistake.” That’s it. Four words that contain infinite possibility. 
Every human has experienced that moment of sudden clarity where past actions reveal themselves as catastrophic. The simplicity of the prompt masks its richness.
Text to video generation transforms these simple fiction prompts into generated footage that captures that singular moment with all its emotional weight intact, allowing a basic story concept to become a complete scene where tension, character, and consequence unfold visually.
Dreamina’s Seedance 2.5 model was engineered to understand how to extract emotional and narrative complexity from deceptively simple prompts, rendering short fiction moments that carry the full weight of human experience despite their apparent simplicity.
The genius of constraint
Short fiction thrives on limitation. A novelist has three hundred pages to develop character and explore theme. A short fiction writer has perhaps three thousand words, sometimes far fewer. That constraint forces ruthless prioritization — every sentence must earn its place, every scene must advance understanding, every moment must matter. This isn’t a handicap; it’s an advantage. Constraint breeds creativity by forcing clarity about what actually matters.
Why simple prompts generate powerful fiction
A paradox exists at the heart of storytelling: the simpler the premise, the more room for meaningful interpretation. A complex, detailed prompt leaves little for a viewer to project onto a scene. A simple prompt invites viewers to recognize themselves in the story, to project their own experiences onto the situation, to complete the emotional picture themselves. That collaborative relationship between creator and viewer is what makes simple fiction prompts so powerful.
Text-to-video actually strengthens this dynamic. A generated scene from a simple prompt doesn’t have a specific actor’s face or particular physical details that might not match a viewer’s imagination.
Character revealed through crisis
Short fiction often skips character introduction entirely and instead reveals character through how someone responds to pressure. A person facing consequences reveals what they actually value through their choices. A character in conflict reveals their priorities through what they’re willing to sacrifice. This approach to characterization is perfect for generated fiction because the generator doesn’t need to show years of development — it only needs to render a moment where character becomes undeniably visible.
A simple prompt about crisis is often more effective than an elaborate character biography. “A person confronting someone they’ve wronged” reveals character through that confrontation more effectively than pages of backstory.
The Power of Seedance 2.5 for Short Fiction
Seedance 2.5 was designed to render brief narrative moments with the emotional precision and character authenticity that make short fiction deeply affecting despite its brevity.
Authentic facial expression and micro-emotion
The model captures subtle shifts in expression that communicate internal state without requiring dialogue or explanation. A character’s realization, doubt, regret, or determination becomes readable through small changes that feel genuine rather than performed.
Natural dialogue delivery with emotional subtext
Dialogue carries layers of meaning beyond literal words. Seedance 2.5 renders how a character says something as much as what they say, making subtext visible and emotional truth apparent through vocal performance.
Spatial storytelling through composition
Character positioning and movement communicate relationship dynamics and emotional stakes. The model understands compositional choices that reveal conflict, connection, or tension through how characters occupy space relative to each other.
Emotional pacing that respects story rhythm
Extended duration allows emotional beats to land with appropriate weight. A revelation needs silence around it. A confrontation needs time to develop. Seedance 2.5 renders pacing that matches the story’s emotional rhythm rather than rushing through narrative.
From prompt to powerful scene
Step 1: Clarify your story’s central moment and create your prompt
Visit Dreamina, sign in, and head to the “AI Video” section. Identify the single moment where your story’s emotional truth becomes most visible. Is it a realization? A confrontation? A decision? A discovery? Click “Add reference image” if you have visual references or mood boards that capture the scene’s tone. Write your fiction prompt focusing on that central moment, describing the character’s internal state, the conflict or stakes, and how the setting participates in the story.
A detailed prompt for a 30-second scene might read: A person sits alone in their car after losing their job, hands gripping the steering wheel, processing the immediate future suddenly becoming uncertain, the familiar parking lot now feeling hostile, their expression cycling through denial to acceptance, the moment where life pivots, shot through the windshield with city lights creating ambient atmosphere, mood devastated but oddly clear. 
Step 2: Generate your fiction scene with Seedance 2.5
Select the Seedance 2.5 model for generation. Choose 30-45 seconds for focused story moments — enough time for emotional beats to land without excess. Pick 16:9 for short film contexts or 9:16 for social platforms. Click Dreamina’s generation icon and watch your simple prompt transform into a complete, emotionally resonant scene.
Step 3: Refine emotional impact and finalize your fiction
Use Dreamina’s AI editing tools to enhance what matters. Upscale sharpens facial expressions and details that communicate emotion, while Generate Soundtrack adds ambient audio that reinforces emotional atmosphere. Review your generated scene — do the emotional beats land? Is the character’s internal state readable? Does the setting participate meaningfully in the story? Once your simple prompt has been rendered into a scene with genuine emotional power, export and share your short fiction creation.
Dialogue as story engine
Short fiction often relies heavily on dialogue because conversation is efficient storytelling. Two characters talking reveal relationship, conflict, stakes, and theme simultaneously. A single exchange can communicate more than paragraphs of narration. This dialogue-driven approach works beautifully with text to video because generated scenes can render how dialogue sounds and lands emotionally rather than just how it reads on a page.
A simple prompt about two characters having one conversation can become a complete scene where their relationship, conflict, and emotional stakes all become visible through dialogue delivery, physical response, and spatial relationship. The simplicity of “two people talking” contains narrative richness that generated footage can make fully visible.
When simplicity contains everything
The most affecting short fiction often emerges from the simplest prompts because simplicity forces clarity about what actually matters. With Dreamina and its Seedance 2.5 model, a basic story idea can become generated footage that captures the full emotional and narrative weight of human experience.
It allows text-to-video to transform simple fiction prompts into powerful scenes that stay with viewers long after they finish watching.

articles.title: Google Maps apporte un changement qui énerve tout un pays
articles.text:
Google Maps modifie l’affichage de sa carte à la suite d’un décret pris par le président américain. Une initiative qui suscite de vives réactions sur les réseaux sociaux, où l’entreprise se voit reprocher son manque de fermeté face aux décisions politiques.
Deux pays, un lac, deux noms
Le changement de nom découle directement d’une modification enregistrée dans le système officiel d’information sur les noms géographiques des États-Unis, le GNIS. Google applique une règle interne établie depuis longtemps, qui est d’adapter ses cartes aux sources gouvernementales officielles de chaque pays. La conséquence directe est que la mention « Lake America » apparaît désormais pour les utilisateurs situés sur le territoire américain.
Mais le nouveau nom n’apparaît pas partout. En effet, au Canada, l’appellation d’origine « Lake Ontario », utilisée depuis le XVIIe siècle et issue d’un terme iroquois signifiant « beau lac », reste inchangée. Pour le reste du monde, l’application fait le choix de la neutralité en superposant les deux dénominations : « Lake Ontario (Lake America) ».
Google Maps n’en est pas à son coup d’essai
L’application de cartographie de Google a déjà été modifiée à la suite de décisions prises par Donald Trump, rebaptisant le golfe du Mexique en « Golfe d’Amérique » ou le mont Denali en « Mount McKinley ». À l’époque, l’entreprise avait été accusée de supprimer des avis négatifs déposés par des internautes en colère à ce sujet.
Découvrez : 25 astuces de pro pour maîtriser Google Maps
Les réactions ne se sont pas fait attendre sur les réseaux sociaux. Plusieurs internautes jugent l’attitude de Google décevante, regrettant une capitulation face au pouvoir politique. D’autres soulignent que de son côté, Apple Maps a pour l’instant conservé le nom historique du lac.

articles.title: 60 000 personnes ont déjà réclamé un pixel des premières images du télescope Nancy Grace Roman
articles.text:
C’est une des missions actuelles dont les résultats sont les plus attendus par la communauté scientifique. Lancé ce week-end, le télescope Nancy Grace Roman doit fournir des données extrêmement précieuses, que ce soit sur des exoplanètes lointaines, ou sur la nature de l’expansion de l’Univers, avec en toile de fond des indices sur la supposée énergie noire.
Et si les scientifiques sont nombreux à compter sur ces images dès que le télescope sera opérationnel, le grand public peut aussi se joindre à la fête. Sur son site, la Nasa propose l’opération « Adopte un pixel ». Le but est de réclamer un seul pixel d’une des premières images qui seront envoyées par Nancy Grace Roman.
Plus de 60 000 pixels déjà réservés
Pour cela, il suffit de remplir un court formulaire sur le site de la Nasa et de fournir une adresse e-mail pour recevoir son certificat avec son numéro unique d’identification. Une adresse ne peut d’ailleurs servir que pour un seul certificat, et à l’heure où nous écrivons ces lignes, plus de 60 000 personnes ont déjà réclamé le leur.
Ces 60 000 réservations ne représentent qu’une goutte d’eau à l’échelle du télescope. Selon la Nasa, les plus petites images du Roman compteront déjà un milliard de pixels, et les plus grandes jusqu’à mille milliards. Adopter un pixel revient donc à s’approprier une part infime de la toute première image, ce qui explique le caractère avant tout symbolique de l’opération.
Tout cela est gratuit, et surtout accessoire, car les images obtenues n’appartiendront en réalité à personne. Au contraire, les données seront immédiatement partagées avec l’ensemble de la communauté scientifique, grâce à un catalogue mis à jour tous les six mois, pour que chacun puisse s’en emparer et construire des théories sur le fonctionnement de l’Univers.
Les adoptants devront toutefois patienter avant de voir « leur » pixel. Le Roman vient tout juste de décoller et entame un voyage de trois mois vers son orbite finale, autour du point de Lagrange L2, à environ 1,5 million de kilomètres de la Terre. La Nasa prévoit de diffuser les premières images début 2027, une fois la phase de calibration des instruments terminée.
Les images obtenues par Roman devraient être fascinantes. La précision de ses instruments, notamment celle du WFI (Wide Field Instrument), sera telle qu’il sera possible d’obtenir des données sur des sources lumineuses extrêmement éloignées et dont l’origine se situe peu de temps après le Big Bang. Le but est de mesurer l’évolution de l’expansion de l’Univers à différentes périodes, là où d’autres, comme le télescope Euclid (avec lequel les données seront partagées), se concentreront sur des phénomènes un peu plus récents.
Des images inédites et très attendues
Les images des exoplanètes sont également très attendues. Elles ne sont que quelques dizaines à avoir été vues directement, sachant que la plupart des planètes extrasolaires connues sont détectées de manière indirecte, grâce à l’effet qu’elles produisent sur les mouvements des étoiles autour desquelles elles orbitent. Ici, le Roman fournira des images jamais vues d’exoplanètes beaucoup plus nombreuses.
La Nasa promet des données très fines sur une partie du ciel 100 fois plus grande que celle observée par l’instrument infrarouge du télescope Hubble. Hubble a justement été conçu en partie grâce à une astronome américaine très brillante, décédée en 2018. Son nom : Nancy Grace Roman.

articles.title: Microsoft alerte sur TerminalFix, une attaque ClickFix taillée pour infiltrer les réseaux internes d'entreprises
articles.text:
Microsoft vient de documenter une nouvelle évolution de ClickFix, capable de maintenir un accès sur un poste compromis et de fournir aux attaquants un point de passage vers le réseau interne de l’entreprise.
Un CAPTCHA qui vous demande d’ouvrir PowerShell n’a évidemment rien d’un CAPTCHA. C’est pourtant le leurre utilisé par TerminalFix, une variante de ClickFix repérée par Microsoft dans une campagne visant plusieurs secteurs d’activité. Une fois la commande exécutée, les attaquants installent un accès persistant sur le PC compromis et déploient un tunnel qui leur permet de poursuivre l’intrusion dans le réseau interne de l’entreprise.
La solution tout-en-un pour protéger votre entreprise
Votre petite entreprise a de grandes ambitions. Protégez-là contre les pirates. Et développez sereinement votre activité !
Une chaîne d’attaque particulièrement élaborée
D’après les équipes de sécurité de Microsoft, les attaquants auraient compromis plusieurs sites pour y injecter de fausses interfaces de vérification Cloudflare, incitant les victimes à copier une commande puis à la coller dans Windows Terminal ou PowerShell. Un choix qui permet aux cybercriminels de faire exécuter des scripts plus longs et plus élaborés qu’en passant par la boîte Exécuter de Windows, souvent privilégiée dans les campagnes ClickFix.
Dans le détail, la commande récupère d’abord une archive contenant un programme Microsoft légitime et une DLL malveillante. Les attaquants s’appuient alors sur le DLL sideloading pour faire charger la bibliothèque piégée par l’exécutable, à la place du fichier attendu.
Le code malveillant peut ensuite poursuivre l’infection, récupérer d’autres composants cachés dans des images PNG et assurer sa persistance après un redémarrage. Il explore aussi l’environnement de l’entreprise pour repérer les comptes Active Directory, les administrateurs du domaine et les serveurs accessibles, avant d’établir un tunnel chiffré vers un serveur contrôlé par les attaquants.
Microsoft précise n’avoir observé ni mouvement latéral, ni vol de données, ni déploiement de rançongiciel dans la campagne analysée. Cet accès pourrait néanmoins permettre aux attaquants de poursuivre leur progression dans le réseau, d’exfiltrer des données, de neutraliser des protections ou, à terme, de déployer un ransomware.
Comment se protéger d’une attaque TerminalFix
La règle la plus importante est aussi la plus simple : si un site vous demande d’ouvrir PowerShell, Windows Terminal ou la boîte Exécuter pour valider un CAPTCHA, ce n’est pas bon signe. Une vérification légitime n’a aucune raison de vous faire copier puis exécuter une commande sur votre PC.
Dans les entreprises, Microsoft recommande aussi de restreindre l’accès à PowerShell et à la boîte Exécuter pour les comptes qui n’en ont pas besoin, à l’aide d’AppLocker, d’Application Control for Windows ou des stratégies de groupe. La journalisation des scripts PowerShell peut également aider les équipes de sécurité à repérer des commandes suspectes, tout comme la surveillance des tentatives de DLL sideloading.
Si la commande malveillante a déjà été exécutée, considérez la machine comme compromise et partez du principe que les attaquants ont pu accéder au réseau interne depuis ce poste. Il faudra alors rechercher d’éventuels mouvements latéraux et renouveler en priorité les identifiants auxquels la machine infectée pouvait avoir accès, notamment ceux des comptes administrateurs.

articles.title: « J'aime cette entreprise » : la lettre d'adieu de Tim Cook à ses équipes pour son dernier jour de CEO d'Apple — Frandroid
articles.text:
« J’aime cette entreprise et l’équipe qui la porte. » C’est par cette phrase que s’ouvre le mot envoyé par Tim Cook aux salariés d’Apple pour son dernier jour de CEO. Le texte a d’abord été révélé par Bloomberg Après quinze ans de règne, Tim Cook ne dresse aucun bilan chiffré : il remercie ses troupes, longuement.
Tim Cook dirigeait Apple depuis août 2011, après avoir succédé à Steve Jobs. En quinze ans, il a hissé la valorisation de l’entreprise au-delà des 4 000 milliards de dollars (près de 3 500 milliards d’euros). Son départ n’avait rien d’un coup de théâtre : Apple l’avait officialisé au printemps.
À partir du 1er septembre, c’est John Ternus, le patron de l’ingénierie matérielle, qui prend la relève. Là où Tim Cook venait des opérations et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, John Ternus est un ingénieur, ce n’est pas un homme de marketing. Le genre de virage qui en dit long sur la maison.
« La culture l’emporte sur tout le reste »
Dans sa lettre, Cook ne parle pas de produits, mais de gens. Il évoque le « privilège d’une vie » d’avoir dirigé ses équipes et répète que sa réussite leur revient entièrement. Il en fait presque une devise : chez Apple, la culture prime sur tout le reste. Il cite Steve Jobs et son idée de laisser une « empreinte dans l’univers », avant de couper court à toute rumeur : « je ne quitte pas Apple ». Il salue enfin son successeur, qu’il qualifie de « brillant, formidable et compétent ».
Officiellement, Cook ne disparaît pas des radars. Apple a confirmé qu’il deviendrait président exécutif du conseil d’administration, avec en charge, notamment, les relations avec les gouvernements. Il avait déjà distillé ses adieux lors de sa dernière keynote, et fait le bilan de ses réussites comme de ses ratés. La signature, elle, quitte le registre corporate : « Avec tout ce que j’ai et tout ce que je suis. »
La lettre de Tim Cook, en intégralité
Voici le texte traduit en français, tel qu’il a été envoyé aux salariés d’Apple.
L’équipe,
Aujourd’hui est mon dernier jour en tant que CEO d’Apple. C’est un moment dont j’ai toujours su qu’il arriverait un jour, et pourtant j’ai encore du mal à croire qu’il soit là et que j’écrive ces mots. J’aime cette entreprise et l’équipe qui la porte, et je ne pouvais pas laisser passer cette journée sans vous adresser un mot, pour vous dire à quel point je suis reconnaissant de l’élan d’affection que vous m’avez témoigné, de la façon dont vous vous êtes présentés chaque jour, et surtout du privilège d’une vie que représente le fait de vous avoir servis comme dirigeant.
La vérité, c’est que quoi qu’on puisse dire de ma réussite, je sais qu’elle vous revient entièrement. Vous avez fait ressortir le meilleur de moi-même. De toute ma vie, je n’avais jamais vu ni côtoyé une équipe aussi extraordinaire, et chaque jour j’en découvre de nouveaux exemples.
Il y a quelque chose de vraiment particulier chez Apple. Ce dont je suis le plus fier, c’est ce qu’un rapport annuel ne pourra jamais capturer. Cet endroit est la preuve que la culture l’emporte sur tout le reste. Nous partageons la conviction que ce que nous construisons compte, et que nous avons à la fois l’opportunité et la responsabilité de laisser le monde meilleur que nous l’avons trouvé. Ce but fait partie de ce qui rend cet endroit extraordinaire. Apple contribue à le nourrir, mais je crois qu’il vivait en chacun de vous bien avant votre arrivée ici. C’est ce qui vous a menés jusqu’à cette entreprise et ce qui continue de porter le travail que vous accomplissez chaque jour. Ensemble, nous avons créé quelque chose de bien plus grand que ce que l’un d’entre nous aurait pu imaginer ou réaliser seul. Et c’est là le secret de notre réussite. Nous faisons ressortir le meilleur les uns des autres. Nous nous élevons mutuellement. Nous avons rendu possible de laisser notre « empreinte dans l’univers », comme Steve l’a un jour décrit, grâce à ce que nous sommes et à ce en quoi nous croyons, grâce à ce que nous valorisons et à la façon dont nous voyons le monde. Quelle chance nous avons. Quelle chance j’ai.
Comme vous le savez, je ne quitte pas Apple. Mais je me retire d’un rôle que j’ai profondément aimé. Ce travail va me manquer d’une manière que je commence à peine à imaginer, tout en restant pleinement en paix avec ma décision. Vous diriger et être à vos côtés à chaque étape va me manquer, même si je trouve un immense réconfort à confier la barre à quelqu’un d’aussi brillant, formidable et compétent que John. Peu de gens comprennent ce qu’il faut pour créer des produits qui changent le monde comme John le comprend, et je ne pourrais être plus enthousiaste à l’idée de son leadership.
J’espère que vous savez à quel point je vous apprécie et quel honneur cela a été d’être votre CEO. Par-dessus tout, j’espère que vous continuerez à être fiers de faire partie de cet endroit remarquable que nous appelons Apple, et que vous lui donnerez toujours le meilleur de vous-mêmes. Quand nous mettons tout notre être dans ce travail, avec de l’attention les uns pour les autres et pour les personnes que nous servons, il n’y a pas de limite à la différence profonde que nous pouvons faire.
J’ai hâte de vous retrouver dans mon nouveau rôle, à Apple Park et partout dans le monde.
Avec tout ce que j’ai et tout ce que je suis, je reste, toujours,
Vôtre,
Tim

articles.title: Spiro names Auroasish Choudhuri as West and Central Africa MD
articles.text:
Spiro, one of Africa’s largest electric motorcycle and battery-swapping companies, has appointed Auroasish Choudhuri as its Managing Director for West and Central Africa.
Choudhuri, who has more than two decades of experience leading automotive businesses across Africa, Asia and the Americas, will oversee Spiro’s mobility business in the two regions and report to Kaushik Burman, its chief executive officer of Mobility, the company said in a Monday statement.
The hiring is the latest wave of appointments at Spiro as the company reshapes its leadership following a $270 million fundraising haul in June. The company appointed former Indofast Energy CEO Anant Badjatya as Group CEO and moved former CEO Burman to lead its mobility services business, separating its rider-facing operations from its ambitions in battery swapping, energy infrastructure, logistics and vehicle manufacturing.
“Auroasish brings extensive experience in growing and transforming automotive businesses across some of the world’s most dynamic markets,” said Anant Badjatya, chief executive officer of Spiro. “His deep understanding of the sector, combined with his track record in market expansion and operational leadership, will be a strong asset as we continue to scale Spiro across Africa.”
Choudhuri joins Spiro from DAG Industries, an automotive and industrial company, where he has served as CEO, overseeing its operations in Nigeria and Benin. Before that, he spent more than a decade at Indian two-wheeler manufacturer TVS Motor Company, serving as Regional Business Head for Asia and, later, Latin America.
Earlier in his career, he led international sales and business development at Escorts Limited across the US, Latin America, West Asia, and Sri Lanka. His experience spans sales, business development, and market expansion.
At Spiro, that experience will be deployed alongside the company’s push to expand its mobility business and launch in new markets.
“Africa is entering an exciting new phase in the transformation of mobility,” Choudhuri said. “I am excited to join Spiro and bring together my automotive expertise and experience of West African markets to support the company’s next phase of growth and expand access to affordable, sustainable mobility across the continent.”
The appointment comes as Spiro expands its ambitions beyond selling electric motorcycles. The company has been building an integrated electric mobility ecosystem around its motorcycles through the battery-swapping infrastructure that allows riders to replace depleted batteries with charged ones.
Spiro assembles vehicles in Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda and operates a battery recycling facility in Nigeria. It also operates in Benin, Togo, and Cameroon and has previously identified Ethiopia and the Democratic Republic of Congo as markets for expansion.
Spiro has also moved to strengthen control over its supply chain by acquiring UK-based two-wheeler engineering specialist Coexlion in May as it moves into vehicle development and manufacturing. The task for the company’s growing leadership team is to build the local infrastructure and supply chains needed to make its battery-swapping model work at scale. With Choudhuri leading West and Central Africa, the company is adding someone whose career has centred on expanding automotive businesses across markets.
True scale demands moving beyond surface-level integrations to robust execution. articles.title: A federal court just ruled Kalshi's sports markets are basically sports betting
articles.text:
TL;DR: A federal appeals court ruled on Friday that Nevada can enforce its gambling laws against Kalshi's sports prediction markets, dealing the company a major setback in its fight to keep state regulators out of the business. The decision could give regulators across the West more leverage to challenge sports contracts offered on federally regulated prediction exchanges, while moving the industry closer to a Supreme Court fight over whether those products are financial derivatives or gambling.
The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals found that Kalshi's sports contracts amount to sports betting, even though the company offers them through a federally regulated exchange. The decision could have implications well beyond Nevada, particularly in states that have been trying to limit or block sports-related prediction markets.
Kalshi lets users trade contracts based on event outcomes. The platform lists markets tied to sports, elections, economic data, weather, entertainment, and other subjects. Its sports contracts have become a major part of its activity as prediction markets have grown quickly this year.
The company has argued that its contracts are federally regulated financial products, not gambling. Kalshi is regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and has said that federal oversight should prevent states from applying their own gaming laws to its operations.
The Ninth Circuit rejected that argument.
"The substance of the sports event contracts offered on Kalshi's (exchange) is sports gambling, regardless of whether Kalshi calls them swaps," the three-judge panel wrote.
The court also said Kalshi had not shown a meaningful difference between its sports markets and traditional sportsbook wagers. "Kalshi's attempts to distinguish its sports event contracts from sportsbooks betting are unpersuasive," the ruling said.
The panel took particular issue with Kalshi's position that its products were not sports betting. The judges said it was "disingenuous" for the company to make that argument after using sports-betting language in earlier marketing materials.
The case began after Nevada regulators moved against Kalshi and similar prediction-market offerings from Crypto.com and Robinhood. Nevada has long treated sports wagering as a tightly regulated activity, and state officials argued that the platforms should be subject to the same rules and taxes as other betting operators.
Gov. Joe Lombardo said the ruling would help "safeguard the integrity of our gaming industry." Mike Dreitzer, chair of the Nevada Gaming Control Board, said it "completely vindicates what we have been saying all along."
Kalshi said it intends to challenge the ruling. Spokeswoman Dani Lever said the company believes CFTC regulations do not bar sports contracts and noted that the agency is considering further clarification of its rules.
"Despite the Ninth Circuit's opinion, we still believe the CFTC regulations as written do not prohibit sports contracts, and in any event, the CFTC is working to clarify those regulations," Lever said in a statement. "We will be seeking further review."
The decision conflicts with a ruling earlier this year from the Third Circuit Court of Appeals. In that case, the court blocked New Jersey from enforcing its gaming laws against Kalshi and other prediction-market companies.
That split raises the odds that the Supreme Court will eventually decide whether federally regulated prediction exchanges can offer sports contracts without state gaming licenses.
"It's the first ruling against Kalshi at the appellate level, and the opinion seemed to be pretty brutal for the company," Dustin Gouker, an independent journalist who covers the prediction industry, told CNN. "This gets us one step closer to an almost inevitable Supreme Court case on the legality of sports event contracts."
The Ninth Circuit's ruling now applies to federal courts in California, Arizona and six other states in the circuit. It could give regulators in those states more leverage as they challenge prediction-market companies.
The ruling comes as the industry is gaining users and trades. Kalshi has reported billions of dollars in weekly trading volume, with sports markets driving much of that activity. Polymarket, the second-largest prediction platform in the United States, was not part of the Nevada case, but the legal issues raised by the ruling could affect its business as well.

articles.title: Anthropic Warns Claude Users of Infostealer Malware Infections
articles.text:
Anthropic has warned some Claude users that infostealer malware on their computers allowed attackers to hijack login sessions and run up usage limits, according to an email the company sent to affected customers.
The company said it detected the activity, signed out the compromised sessions, and removed saved payment methods from affected accounts as a precaution.
Anthropic is alerting Claude AI users whose computers were infected with infostealer malware such as Vidar, Lumma, StealC, RedLine, and Acreed on Windows, along with Atomic Stealer (AMOS) on a small number of macOS devices.
The AI giant emphasized that the malware is general-purpose and not tied to Claude itself, typically arriving via unofficial downloads or malicious apps.
The company said the malware quietly copies saved passwords, browser login cookies, and credentials for other local applications.
Anthropic believes a threat actor subsequently began selecting the stolen Claude sessions out of that harvested data and using them to access accounts. Users who saw their usage limits appear to refill and then drain without actively using Claude were told this was the likely cause.
In response to the campaign, Anthropic signed out the affected sessions and warned it may sign users out again if it observes further signs of account misuse.
The company also said it removed saved payment methods so accounts could not be charged, and users must add a payment method again to renew or make further purchases. Anthropic also noted that it refunded any Claude charges it identified as unauthorized.
Victims of this campaign have been told to only re-add a payment method after ensuring that all malware has been removed from their computers.

articles.title: ChatGPT and Reddit now face EU's toughest online safety rules
articles.text: OpenAI’s ChatGPT will have to comply with tougher EU rules such as removing illegal content or face potential fines, the European Commission said on Monday, as Brussels grapples with how its existing digital regulation applies to rapidly evolving AI services. The Commission said the chatbot, social media forum Reddit, and gaming platform Roblox would be classified as so-called very large online platforms under the EU Digital Services Act, its landmark online safety regime. The designation means all three services will face additional obligations such as removing illegal content and protecting the privacy and security of minors and could face fines of up to 6 percent of their global revenue if they fail to comply.
